message.content: Is the logout plan ready to build?

content.text: Yes. The DAG is 1-wide: end-session's after-edge on token-revocation serialises the build, so implement cannot fan out. Acceptance 4 is proven by end-session on token-revocation's behalf, which is fine because the later slice owns the cross check. Both done lines fail today, so neither check is vacuous. Approve both files and run /craft:implement logout.
